notes.value: Jaecoo J5 SHS-H, a self-charging hybrid (no plug) with Chery's 1.5 TGDI engine and a dedicated hybrid transmission, sold by NexGen Auto (Nishat Group). Per Omoda & Jaecoo Pakistan: 221 hp / 165 kW and 295 Nm combined, 1.83 kWh battery, 0-100 km/h 7.9 s, 950+ km driving range, WLTP 5.3 L/100 km, 51 L tank, 18-inch wheels, 4380 x 1860 x 1650 mm, 2620 mm wheelbase, 176 mm ground clearance. Top speed 175 km/h and the 480 L boot are from PakNEV. Two versions: Comfort PKR 6,999,000 (halogen automatic headlamps, 9-inch screen, 2 speakers, fabric seats, manual driver seat, dual front airbags) and Premium PKR 7,999,000 (adds LED headlamps, 540-degree camera, panoramic glass roof, 13.2-inch screen, 8 speakers, 50 W wireless charging, faux-leather ventilated seats, power driver seat, adaptive cruise control, side and curtain airbags). Both prices rose by PKR 300,000 on 1 October 2026 when the launch price lock (PKR 6,699,000 / 7,699,000) ended; freight and insurance of PKR 55,000 are extra. Kerb weight is not published for Pakistan. Sources: https://omodajaecoo.pk/jaecoo-j5-shs-h, https://headless-cms.omodajaecoo.pk/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Jaecoo-J5-Specifications-A4.pdf, https://www.pakwheels.com/blog/omoda-and-jaecoo-car-prices-revised-following-tax-change/, https://paknev.com/cars/jaecoo-j5-shs.
